# Contributions

`contributes` is where a plugin declares what it adds. Each kind below is a key
under it; every one is optional, and the cross-field invariants in `manifest.md`
decide which entry module and which capability each kind requires.

## Widgets

A widget is a canvas card. The manifest owns its DURABLE schema — the type, its
props, its size behaviour — and code binds a component to it. `widgets.md` is
the deep end; the field table is here.

Categories: `Cards`, `3D`, `Nodes`, `Tools`.

| field | type | required | rules |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | string | yes | at most 128 characters |
| `title` | string | yes | at least 1 character; at most 80 characters |
| `description` | string | no | at most 500 characters |
| `icon` | string | no | asset paths are ./-relative POSIX, no .., no schemes |
| `category` | `Cards` \| `3D` \| `Nodes` \| `Tools` | no | — |
| `preview` | one of `color`, `gradient`, `asset` | no | discriminated by `kind` |
| `schemaVersion` | number | yes | `integer; > 0` |
| `surface` | `dom` \| `gl` | yes | — |
| `sizeMode` | `fixed` \| `auto-height` \| `auto` | yes | — |
| `defaultSize` | { w: number, h: number } | yes | — |
| `minSize` | { w: number, h: number } | no | — |
| `maxSize` | { w: number, h: number } | no | — |
| `interaction` | { selectable?: boolean, movable?: boolean, resizable?: boolean, snap?: `source` \| `target` \| `both` \| `none`, dragOn?: `press` \| `longPress`, solid?: boolean, sweepContained?: boolean, keyboard?: `shared` \| `exclusive`, keyboardEscape?: `release` \| `widget` } | no | — |
| `container` | `{ accepts: string[], provides?: string[] }` | no | — |
| `provides` | `string[]` | no | at most 16 item(s) |
| `ports` | { id: string, side: `n` \| `e` \| `s` \| `w`, index?: number, accepts?: string[] }[] | no | at most 16 item(s) |
| `props` | object mapping name → one of `string`, `number`, `boolean`, `enum`, `json`, `entity-ref`, `session-ref`, `terminal-ref`, `artifact-ref`, `file-ref` | no | discriminated by `kind`; defaults to `{}` |
| `groups` | `object mapping name → string[]` | no | at least 1 item(s); defaults to `{}` |

```json
[
  {
    "type": "com.example.notes",
    "title": "Note",
    "description": "A sticky note",
    "category": "Cards",
    "preview": {
      "kind": "color",
      "value": "#F6E7A9"
    },
    "schemaVersion": 1,
    "surface": "dom",
    "sizeMode": "fixed",
    "defaultSize": {
      "w": 260,
      "h": 180
    },
    "minSize": {
      "w": 120,
      "h": 90
    },
    "props": {
      "text": {
        "kind": "string",
        "default": "",
        "maxLength": 4000
      },
      "color": {
        "kind": "enum",
        "options": [
          "yellow",
          "blue",
          "pink"
        ],
        "default": "yellow"
      }
    },
    "groups": {
      "text": [
        "text"
      ],
      "color": [
        "color"
      ]
    }
  }
]
```

## Commands

A command is an invocable action the spine places (palette, context menus, HUD,
godview). The spine owns ordering, args validation and provenance; the plugin
binds a handler with `ctx.commands.register(id, handler)`.

| field | type | required | rules |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | at most 128 characters |
| `title` | string | yes | at least 1 character; at most 80 characters |
| `description` | string | no | at most 500 characters |
| `icon` | string | no | asset paths are ./-relative POSIX, no .., no schemes |
| `placements` | `palette` \| `widget-context` \| `canvas-context` \| `hud` \| `godview`[] | yes | at least 1 item(s) |
| `args` | object | no | — |

```json
[
  {
    "id": "com.example.tools.tidy",
    "title": "Tidy the selection",
    "description": "Align the selected widgets to a grid",
    "placements": [
      "palette",
      "canvas-context"
    ],
    "args": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "spacing": {
          "type": "number",
          "minimum": 1
        }
      }
    }
  }
]
```

*(authored for these docs, validated at generation time)*

## Surfaces

A surface is a React component the spine mounts in a named slot. The SLOT is
manifest truth — a component cannot choose where it appears — and only a side
panel is given a `requestClose()`. Bind with `ctx.surfaces.register(id, Component)`.

| field | type | required | rules |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | at most 128 characters |
| `title` | string | yes | at least 1 character; at most 80 characters |
| `slot` | `hud.attention` \| `hud.panel` \| `hud.side-panel` \| `godview.row` \| `godview.lens` | yes | — |
| `icon` | string | no | asset paths are ./-relative POSIX, no .., no schemes |
| `order` | number | no | — |

```json
[
  {
    "id": "com.example.tools.panel",
    "title": "Tools",
    "slot": "hud.side-panel",
    "order": 10
  }
]
```

*(authored for these docs, validated at generation time)*

## Settings

Declared keys only. Each property carries a title, a scope (`user` syncs,
`device` stays local, `secret` never leaves the keychain) and a JSON Schema the
host validates writes against. Reading them from code requires `storage.self`,
and the values arrive through `ctx.settings`.

| field | type | required | rules |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `properties` | object mapping name → { title: string, description?: string, scope: `user` \| `device` \| `secret`, schema: object } | yes | — |

```json
{
  "properties": {
    "sampleHz": {
      "title": "Sample rate",
      "scope": "user",
      "schema": {
        "type": "number",
        "minimum": 1,
        "maximum": 60,
        "default": 10
      }
    }
  }
}
```

*(@vibefield/contracts fixtures/plugin-manifest.service.json)*

## Dynamic services

A service entry may expose methods under its own `x.<pluginId>` namespace. Each
method declares its kind, the capability a caller must hold, whether it is
idempotent, and its JSON Schemas. The host validates both directions, so an
invalid input never reaches the provider and an invalid output becomes
`PLUGIN_SCHEMA_VIOLATION`.

Method kinds:

- `query` — `name`, `requiredCapability`, `idempotent`, `locality`, `input`, `description`, `output`
- `mutation` — `name`, `requiredCapability`, `idempotent`, `locality`, `input`, `description`, `output`
- `subscription` — `name`, `requiredCapability`, `idempotent`, `locality`, `input`, `description`, `snapshot`, `delta`

| field | type | required | rules |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `namespace` | string | yes | matches `/^x\./` |
| `methods` | one of `query`, `mutation`, `subscription`[] | yes | each item: discriminated by `kind`; at least 1 item(s); at most 64 item(s) |

```json
[
  {
    "namespace": "x.com.example.metrics",
    "methods": [
      {
        "name": "snapshot",
        "kind": "query",
        "requiredCapability": "x.com.example.metrics.read",
        "idempotent": true,
        "locality": "local",
        "input": {
          "type": "object",
          "additionalProperties": false
        },
        "output": {
          "type": "object",
          "required": [
            "sampledAt",
            "values"
          ],
          "properties": {
            "sampledAt": {
              "type": "number"
            },
            "values": {
              "type": "array",
              "items": {
                "type": "number"
              },
              "maxItems": 1000
            }
          },
          "additionalProperties": false
        }
      }
    ]
  }
]
```

*(@vibefield/contracts fixtures/plugin-manifest.service.json)*

## Canvas systems

A system runs after the engine step, inside a budget the spine enforces. The
`reason` field is the honesty tax: frame cadence is a scarce power, and a system
says why it needs one.

| field | type | required | rules |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | at most 128 characters |
| `phase` | `"tick"` | yes | — |
| `budgetMs` | number | yes | `> 0; ≤ 16` |
| `reason` | string | yes | at least 1 character; at most 500 characters |

```json
[
  {
    "id": "com.example.metrics.ticker",
    "phase": "tick",
    "budgetMs": 1,
    "reason": "advance the live sparkline between service snapshots"
  }
]
```

*(@vibefield/contracts fixtures/plugin-manifest.service.json)*

## Custom capabilities

A plugin that provides services can define the capabilities that gate them:
`x.<pluginId>.<name>`, with a risk level the user sees when granting.

| field | type | required | rules |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | `custom capabilities are x.<pluginId>.<name>` |
| `title` | string | yes | at least 1 character; at most 80 characters |
| `description` | string | yes | at least 1 character; at most 500 characters |
| `risk` | `read` \| `write` \| `execute` \| `sensitive` | yes | — |

```json
[
  {
    "id": "x.com.example.metrics.read",
    "title": "Read local metrics",
    "description": "Returns the metrics collected by this plugin",
    "risk": "read"
  }
]
```

*(@vibefield/contracts fixtures/plugin-manifest.service.json)*

## MCP

`tools` project already-declared service methods to agents; `servers` declare
external MCP servers whose transport settings come from DECLARED settings keys
(a url from a `device`-scope key, a secret from a `secret`-scope one) — never
from literals in the manifest.

| field | type | required | rules |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tools` | `{ name: string, title: string, description: string, method: string }[]` | no | at most 32 item(s) |
| `servers` | { id: string, transport: one of `stdio`, `http`, autoStart?: boolean }[] | no | at most 16 item(s) |

```json
{
  "tools": [
    {
      "name": "metrics-snapshot",
      "title": "Metrics snapshot",
      "description": "Read the current metrics sample",
      "method": "x.com.example.metrics.snapshot"
    }
  ]
}
```

*(@vibefield/contracts fixtures/plugin-manifest.service.json)*
